title: Final Balance and Late Charge Figures: Entry & Patio Door Contracts
content:
The final balance on Entry & Patio Door Contracts falls due a fixed number of calendar days after the installation completion date; an unpaid balance after that date attracts a late balance charge at a rate per period, with a smallest charge per period.

| Door series | Final balance due after installation completion | Late charge rate per full 30-day period after the due date | Smallest late balance charge per period |
|---|---|---|---|
| Ridgeline Portal 310 Steel Entry Door | 5 calendar days | 1.5% | $15.00 |
| Ridgeline Portal 520 Smooth Fiberglass Entry Door | 5 calendar days | 1.5% | $15.00 |
| Ridgeline Glide 720 Vinyl Sliding Patio Door | 5 calendar days | 1.5% | $15.00 |
| Ridgeline Portal 640 Woodgrain Fiberglass Entry Door | 5 calendar days | 1.5% | $15.00 |
| Ridgeline Glide 840 Fiberglass Sliding Patio Door | 5 calendar days | 1.5% | $15.00 |
| Ridgeline Hinge 960 Wood-Clad French Patio Door | 5 calendar days | 1.5% | $15.00 |

## Definitions

- **Final balance due**: the calendar days after the installation completion date within which the remaining balance is due.
- **Late charge rate**: the rate applied to the unpaid balance for each full 30-day period after the final balance due date, as a decimal fraction per period (0.015, that is 1.5%).
- **Smallest late charge**: the smallest late balance charge assessed for a period, in US dollars.

## Hypothetical figures

| Unpaid balance (hypothetical) | Rate times balance | Late charge for the period |
|---|---|---|
| $3000.00 | $45.00 | $45.00 |
| $1000.00 | $15.00 | $15.00 |
| $600.00 | $9.00 | $15.00 (the smallest charge) |

The figures are identical across all six door series: 5 calendar days, 1.5% and $15.00.
